title: Concept: Dependency pulls its full default feature surface
description: Cargo.toml declares a dependency that keeps all default features on, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency that keeps all default features on.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
